text: a vitamin B substance. It is a component of coenzyme A which is essential in the metabolism of carbohydrate, fat, and protein. Deficiency of pantothenic acid is unlikely in man because of its widespread distribution in food. Pantothenic acid has no accepted therapeutic uses in human medicine, though it has been given by mouth as a nutritional sup- plement, often as the calcium salt and usually with other vitamins of the B group.
